name: Midara na Ore <♀> no Mitabi no Hen'you
original_name: 淫らなオレ＜♀＞の３度の変容
source:
Kei Ayahara, high school social studies teacher.
Reasonably popular at school, a comfortable job, and trouble free days.
He even had a secret, exciting love affair with a young student.

A perfect life.

But then he "glitched" from male to female.

A virtual reality/psychological story about becoming a woman with a man's mind and soul. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE125638.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
绫原圭，高中社会学老师。
在学校相当受欢迎，工作舒适，日子无忧无虑。
他甚至与一名年轻学生有一段秘密的、令人兴奋的恋情。

完美的生活。

但后来他“故障”地从男性变成了女性。

一个关于成为拥有男人思想和灵魂的女人的虚拟现实/心理故事。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE125638.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
